title: exudev issue plot: the issues over time as a matplotlib figure
author: Claude-JG
description: The maintainer, 2026-09-29: 'exudev issue plot' opens a matplotlib figure with the issues over time - total, closed and open - and, on a second scale, total and open bugs and fixes, with a legend. revision2026b step RG10.13.
releaseNotes: exudev issue plot shows the issues over time - total, closed, open, and the bugs and fixes on a second axis; --save FILE writes the figure.
